about.paragraph2: Your visit will connect you with a landscape born of grit, passion and Uruguayan bloodlines, carried forward by new generations devoted to working the Cachapoal earth.

hero.subtitle: A passion for the land and for wine, passed down each harvest, is what defines us at Viña Casa Acosta.

origin.title: The roots of a dream
origin.body: Viña Casa Acosta was born from the dream of Nelson Acosta, a renowned figure in South American football who, arriving from his native Uruguay, put down roots in the small rural village of Estación Francia, in the Cachapoal Valley. There he worked as a hunter and telegraph operator, among other trades. The name of his village evoked that distant European country he would reach in 1998 as head coach of the Chilean national team — the same year that, having bought this land shortly before travelling to the World Cup in France, he planted the first vines.
origin.imageAlt: The old Estación Francia at golden hour: the railway tracks and the station's wooden sign

card1.title: A warm welcome
card1.body: Sheep, goats, rabbits, geese and ostriches greet you on arrival: the atmosphere is familial in every sense, and every detail has a story to tell. Giant ombú trees echo the distant Uruguayan plains where this dream was born. The entire process is done by hand — maceration, fermentation, draining, pressing, filtering and bottling — on the estate itself, where every bond is person to person. From the 1,200 bottles of the first vintage in 2003, today we craft 7,300 a year.
card1.imageAlt: An old wooden cart wheel, a nod to the estate's roots and tradition

card2.title: A legacy in three labels
card2.body: Today, thanks to his son Damián Acosta, that dream has flowered into an artisanal craft made at human scale. «Ombú» — the strong, surface-rooted tree common in Uruguay and in the plazas of central Chile — is our first line, our way of saying that everything grows from deep roots. Soon comes the second, the Gran Reserva «Estación Francia», and the story will be completed by the Icon series «Nelson Acosta»: a definitive tribute to our founder.
card2.imageAlt: A carved oak wine barrel marked 1906, a symbol of the artisanal craft

staffCta.text: Behind this story is a team that makes it possible.

damian.name: Damián Acosta
damian.bio: As co-founder of Viña Casa Acosta, Damián drives a place where tradition and innovation come together to offer authentic experiences. His commitment shows in every step, always guided by respect for the land and the pursuit of unique moments for each visitor. With a close, family-minded vision, he works to make the winery a place where nature and human warmth can flourish. He also seeks for every wine to carry a personal signature that reflects the identity and passion of the winery — a legacy shared with his father and family that gives life and soul to every glass.

andrea.name: Andrea Leyton
andrea.bio: Andrea brings the experiences at Viña Casa Acosta to life with dedication and passion. As Event Planner, she designs every detail so that celebrations and activities reflect the close, family essence that defines the winery. Her warm, professional touch creates unique settings where every visitor feels special, and each moment becomes an unforgettable memory shared as a family.

enrique.name: Enrique Pizarro
enrique.bio: Enrique is the green heart of Viña Casa Acosta. With deep respect for the land, he tends every vine and every leaf as a living legacy. His passion and knowledge guide the growth of our vineyards, ensuring that each cluster reflects the nobility of our terroir. Thanks to his commitment, the winery flourishes with harmony and quality, giving life to wines that tell unique, authentic stories.

alfonso.name: Alfonso Duarte
alfonso.bio: Alfonso is the soul behind every bottle of Viña Casa Acosta. With sensitivity and craft, he transforms the nobility of the grapes into wines of character and elegance. His passion and experience are reflected in every glass, where tradition and innovation meet to tell our story. Alfonso works with respect for the land and an absolute commitment to quality, making every harvest unique and memorable.

ombu-carmenere.shortDescription: 100% Carmenere Reserve, with intense spice and ripe black fruit.
ombu-carmenere.description: Deep cherry red. A complex nose of intense spice and ripe black fruit. On the palate, soft, round tannins, good structure and a long, pleasant finish.

ombu-tannat.shortDescription: 100% Reserve Tannat, with firm tannins and good ageing potential.
ombu-tannat.description: Cherry red. On the nose, aromas of black fruit such as blueberry and blackberry, with some spice like black pepper and clove. Complex-bodied, with firm tannins, balanced acidity and good ageing potential.

ombu-sauvignon.shortDescription: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon from the Cachapoal Valley, balanced and silky.
ombu-sauvignon.description: A fresh nose of nuts, spice and ripe red fruit, with a slight touch of vanilla. Balanced and fleshy, with present yet silky tannins, good volume and a long, very persistent finish.

lajau-sam.shortDescription: Carmenere–Tannat blend, structured with a long finish.
lajau-sam.description: Aromas of very ripe black fruit, spice and bitter chocolate. On the palate it is structured, balanced and with a long aftertaste.

lajau-deti.shortDescription: Blend of Carmenere, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot — elegant and complex.
lajau-deti.description: An intriguing cherry red with fresh, complex aromas: intense black fruit, cocoa and smoke. A structured palate with soft, elegant tannins, long and with a pleasant finish.

lajau-betum.shortDescription: A four-variety blend, complex and full-bodied.
lajau-betum.description: A deep ruby red with violet hints. Very complex: ripe red fruit and black fruit, with touches of smoke and pepper. A palate of good structure and volume, with juicy tannins, great aftertaste and a long finish.

lajau-betum-yu.shortDescription: A five-variety blend — the apex of the Lajau line.
lajau-betum-yu.description: A deep ruby red, with present yet round tannins and balanced acidity. A finish with a touch of bitter chocolate and some smoke, long on the palate.

estacion-francia-carmenere.shortDescription: Grand Reserve of Carmenere and Petit Verdot, of great complexity and ageing.
estacion-francia-carmenere.description: A vivid morello-cherry red with violet notes. Aromas of black fruit, chocolate and spice, with touches of redcurrant, nuts and tobacco. On the palate, silky tannins; juicy and well balanced, with a persistent finish.

estacion-francia-tannat.shortDescription: Grand Reserve of Tannat and Carmenere, powerful and structured.
estacion-francia-tannat.description: Deeply colored. Aromas of ripe red fruit, plum and blackberry, with touches of black cherry and tobacco notes. A powerful, greatly structured palate, robust in body, long and persistent.

bera.shortDescription: Fresh, floral rosé of Carmenere and Cabernet Sauvignon.
bera.description: A pink-colored rosé with a complex profile. Aromas of fresh raspberry, very floral, with notes of red cherry. A fresh palate with intriguing acidity, juicy and with a pleasant finish.

guidai.shortDescription: Rosé sparkling wine, fresh and fine-bubbled.
guidai.description: A pale-pink sparkling wine. Aromas of strawberry, with a spicy touch. A whitish mousse with persistent fine bubbles; fresh and with balanced acidity.

yaray-gua-tinto.shortDescription: Late-harvest Carmenere, luscious with balanced sweetness.
yaray-gua-tinto.description: A brick-red color. Aromas of candied red fruit, figs and honey. On the palate it is luscious, with balanced sweetness and an acidity that keeps it from being cloying.

yaray-gua-blanco.shortDescription: Late-harvest white, unctuous with a complex finish.
yaray-gua-blanco.description: A golden-yellow color with marked amber, bright reflections. Full-volumed and powerful, with pleasant, firm and vibrant acidity. A very long, unctuous finish with a complex aftertaste where notes of bitter-orange marmalade, toasted nuts and a subtle touch of honey return.

pizzas.name: Pizza Workshop
pizzas.description: Knead, stretch and build your own pizza, bake it in a traditional oven and share it fresh out, glass of wine in hand.
pizzas.tagline: Knead, bake and share, glass in hand
pizzas.intro: We'll make the dough from scratch, knead it, stretch it and build your own pizza. Then we'll bake it and share it as a group, straight out of the oven and with a glass of wine.
pizzas.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
includes: Wine tasting: on arrival, during the workshop and at the close.
pizzas.closing: You leave with the recipe, dough to do it again at home, and the table talk.

pastas.name: Pasta Workshop
pastas.description: Make the dough from scratch, roll it out and cut it into different shapes, then share the fresh pasta with a glass of wine.
pastas.tagline: From the dough to the plate, glass in hand
pastas.intro: We'll make the dough from scratch, knead it, roll it out and cut it into different shapes. Then we'll cook it and share it as a group, enjoying the fresh pasta with a glass of wine.
pastas.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
includes: Wine tasting: on arrival, during the workshop and at the close.
pastas.closing: You leave with the recipe, the cut you learned, and the table talk.

noquis.name: Gnocchi Workshop
noquis.description: Make the dough, shape the gnocchi and pair them with homemade sauces to close with a shared dinner.
noquis.tagline: Shape it, cook it, and close with a group dinner
noquis.intro: We'll make the dough from scratch, knead it, cut it and shape the gnocchi, then cook them and pair them with homemade sauces. To finish, we'll share the finished dish over a group dinner.
noquis.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
includes: Wine tasting: on arrival, during the workshop and at the close.
noquis.closing: You leave with the recipe, the sauces written down, and the dinner you shared.

ombu.name: Ombú Tour
ombu.description: An introduction to the world of wine: walk our Carménère vineyards, the cellar and the barrel room, with a guided tasting.
highlights: 3 wines from the Ombú and Lajau lines
ombu.tagline: An introduction to the world of wine at Casa Acosta
ombu.intro: Ideal for those who want to get to know our winery from its roots, walking our Carménère vineyards, cellar and barrel room, alongside a guided tasting.
ombu.reservationNote: Ideally 1 day ahead or subject to availability
includes: Welcome at the Varieties Garden with a welcome glass of Berá Rosé Carménère.
Tour of the cellar, winemaking room and barrel room, with a full explanation of the wine's production process, from vine to glass.
wines: Tasting of 3 wines from the Ombú and/or Lajau lines.
ombu.closing: You'll be able to purchase our wines directly at the cellar.

bera.name: Berá Tour
bera.description: A deeper, more technical experience: different expressions of Carménère, from the barrel to our most complex lines.
bera.tagline: Premium tasting and wine straight from the barrel
bera.intro: A deeper, more technical experience, ideal for those who want to explore different expressions of Carménère, from the barrel to our most complex lines.
bera.reservationNote: Ideally 1 day ahead or subject to availability
includes: Welcome at the Varieties Garden with a welcome glass of Berá Rosé Carménère.
Tour of the cellar, winemaking room and barrel room, with a full explanation of the wine's production process, from vine to glass.
Tasting straight from the barrel, to experience the wine during its aging stage.
wines: 2 wines from the Lajau and/or Ombú lines.
bera.closing: Our wines will be available for sale at the cellar itself.

carmenere.name: Carménère Tour
carmenere.description: Our premium experience focused on our signature varietal: its origin, ampelography and expression across different wine lines.
carmenere.tagline: Go deep into our signature varietal
carmenere.intro: A tour focused on the history and characteristics of Carménère, exploring in depth its origin, morphology (ampelography) and expression across different wine lines.
carmenere.reservationNote: Ideally 1 day ahead or subject to availability
includes: Welcome at the Varieties Garden with a welcome glass of Berá Rosa Carménère.
Vineyard walk focused on ampelography: a technical explanation of the Carménère variety and its history at Casa Acosta.
Tour of the cellar, winemaking room and barrel room, with a full explanation of the wine's production process, from vine to glass.
Tasting straight from the barrel, to get to know the wine during its aging stage.
carmenere.closing: You'll have the option to purchase our wines directly at the cellar.

cosecha-tu-historia.name: Harvest Your Story
cosecha-tu-historia.description: You work a defined set of vines through the whole cycle and follow your own grapes in the cellar until they're bottled.
cosecha-tu-historia.tagline: Your own grapes, from pruning to bottle
cosecha-tu-historia.intro: A one-of-a-kind, personal experience where you do real work on a defined set of vines, from pruning through harvest. Then you follow your own grapes into the cellar, watching their fermentation, blending and final bottling up close. A complete, traceable and deeply meaningful connection with the wine you helped create.
cosecha-tu-historia.reservationNote: The full cycle is arranged with the winery
cosecha-tu-historia.closing: You harvested your story and bottled it: that bottle carries your work across the whole cycle.

enologo-por-un-dia.name: Winemaker for a Day
enologo-por-un-dia.description: Guided by a winemaker, you create your own wine, judge it blind and compete for the best blend of the group.
enologo-por-un-dia.tagline: Build your blend, taste it blind, compete for the best
enologo-por-un-dia.intro: A one-of-a-kind experience where every participant becomes a winemaker for a day, guided by a winemaker. You'll create your own wine, judge it blind and compete for the best blend. Fun, learning and team spirit in one unforgettable session.
enologo-por-un-dia.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
program: Half-time: a sensory pause with a pairing
enologo-por-un-dia.closing: You leave with the bottle you blended and, if the group says so, with the prize.

mimbre.name: Wicker Workshop
mimbre.description: From preparing the wicker to weaving your own piece, alongside craftspeople from the area.
mimbre.tagline: Weave your own piece alongside local craftspeople
mimbre.intro: A craft experience where tradition and creativity come together. Alongside local artisans, you'll learn everything from preparing the wicker to weaving your own piece, in a warm setting full of history. A day to reconnect with what's made by hand, enjoy local flavours and take home a keepsake woven with roots.
mimbre.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
mimbre.closing: You leave with the piece you wove and the craft seen up close.

yoga.name: Yoga: breathe, stretch and share
yoga.description: Outdoor yoga among the vines, a healthy brunch and local producers, in one unhurried morning.
yoga.tagline: A session among the vines, and a brunch to close
yoga.intro: A wellbeing experience among the vines that invites you to connect body, mind and nature. It combines an outdoor yoga session with a healthy brunch and the chance to discover local products in a calm, harmonious setting.
yoga.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
yoga.closing: You leave loose, and with the morning well started.

cena-sensorial.name: Sensory Dinner
cena-sensorial.description: Five courses paired with our labels, guided by the winemaker, the chef and the sommelier.
cena-sensorial.tagline: Five courses, each with its own label
cena-sensorial.intro: A dining experience that invites you to discover wine with every sense: five carefully designed courses, each paired with one of our labels, chosen to bring out the best in the dish. Through the evening, our winemaker, chef and sommelier guide the table across the aromas, flavours and feelings each pairing awakens.
cena-sensorial.reservationNote: Subject to availability — we arrange the date with you
cena-sensorial.closing: You leave having tasted five pairings, and having heard why each one works.
